paragraphs.text: In a dry region of the south-west, a town council decided in 2018 that new houses could not have grass in their front gardens. Existing lawns were allowed, but no new ones could be laid.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Water use fell by a tenth within three years. Most of the saving came from a few large gardens rather than from many small ones, because the largest users had been watering daily.
paragraphs.label: B

paragraphs.text: Gardeners found substitutes. Gravel with drought-tolerant shrubs is the commonest, though some households chose a small paved terrace with pots that can be moved into shade.
paragraphs.label: C

paragraphs.text: The rule has critics. Older residents say that a green lawn cooled the street, and measurements show that gravel gardens are indeed several degrees warmer in the afternoon.
paragraphs.label: D

items.quote: new houses could not have grass in their front gardens

explanation.en: The council’s decision: no new lawns → i.
explanation.kk: Әкімдіктің шешімі: жаңа көгал тыйым салынған → i.
explanation.ru: Решение совета: новые газоны запрещены → i.

items.quote: Water use fell by a tenth within three years.

explanation.en: How much water was saved and by whom → ii.
explanation.kk: Қанша су үнемделді және кімнің есебінен → ii.
explanation.ru: Сколько воды сэкономили и за счёт кого → ii.

explanation.en: What replaced the lawn: gravel, shrubs, pots → iii.
explanation.kk: Көгалды немен алмастырды: қиыршық тас, бұта, құмыра → iii.
explanation.ru: Чем заменили газон: гравий, кустарники, горшки → iii.

items.quote: gravel gardens are indeed several degrees warmer in the afternoon

explanation.en: The drawback: gravel gardens are warmer in the afternoon → iv.
explanation.kk: Кемшілігі: қиыршық тасты бақ күндіз ыстықтау → iv.
explanation.ru: Минус: гравийные сады теплее днём → iv.

headings.text: A drawback of the new gardens
